passages.text: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
passages.sermon:
Mary Magdalene was a follower of Jesus.
The other Mary was also a follower of Jesus.
The Sabbath had ended.
It was dawn on the first day of the week.
Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to the tomb.
They wanted to see the tomb.
passages.original: Ὀψὲ δὲ σαββάτων τῇ ἐπιφωσκούσῃ εἰς μίαν σαββάτων ἦλθεν Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία θεωρῆσαι τὸν τάφον

passages.text: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
passages.sermon:
A great earthquake happened.
An angel of the Lord came down from heaven.
The angel went to the tomb.
The angel rolled away the stone.
The angel sat on the stone.
passages.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας ἄγγελος γὰρ Κυρίου καταβὰς ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ προσελθὼν ἀπεκύλισεν τὸν λίθον καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ

passages.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
passages.sermon: The angel of the Lord appeared.\r\nHis appearance was like lightning.\r\nHis clothes were white as snow.
passages.original: ἦν δὲ ἡ εἰδέα αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀστραπὴ καὶ τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ λευκὸν ὡς χιών

passages.text: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
passages.sermon:
The guards stood by the tomb.
They saw the angel of the Lord.
They became very afraid of him.
They shook with fear.
They became like dead men.
passages.original: ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ φόβου αὐτοῦ ἐσείσθησαν οἱ τηροῦντες καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ὡς νεκροί

passages.text: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
passages.sermon:
An angel stood before the women.
The angel spoke to them.
The angel said, “Do not be afraid.”
The angel knew the women were looking for Jesus.
Jesus had been crucified.
The women searched for Jesus, who was crucified.
passages.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν ταῖς γυναιξίν Μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὑμεῖς οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον ζητεῖτε

passages.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is not here.
Jesus has risen.
He rose just as He said He would.
Come.
See the place where Jesus lay.
passages.original: οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε ἠγέρθη γὰρ καθὼς εἶπεν δεῦτε ἴδετε τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἔκειτο

passages.text: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to the women.
The angel gave them instructions.
The angel said, "Go quickly."
The angel told them to find Jesus' disciples.
The angel said, "Tell His disciples this message."
The angel said, "Jesus has risen from the dead."
The angel said, "Jesus is going ahead of you into Galilee."
The angel said, "You will see Him there."
The angel said, "I have told you this."
passages.original: καὶ ταχὺ πορευθεῖσαι εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ἰδοὺ προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε ἰδοὺ εἶπον ὑμῖν

passages.text: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.
passages.sermon:
The women left the tomb quickly.
They felt afraid.
They also felt great joy.
They ran to tell Jesus’ disciples.
passages.original: Καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ταχὺ ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου μετὰ φόβου καὶ χαρᾶς μεγάλης ἔδραμον ἀπαγγεῖλαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is alive.
Jesus met the women suddenly.
Jesus spoke to them.
Jesus said, “Greetings!”
The women came close to Jesus.
They held His feet.
They worshiped Jesus.
passages.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἰησοῦς ὑπήντησεν αὐταῖς λέγων Χαίρετε αἱ δὲ προσελθοῦσαι ἐκράτησαν αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ

passages.text: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the women.
Jesus said, “Do not be afraid.”
Jesus told them, “Go and tell My brothers.”
Jesus said, “Tell them to go to Galilee.”
Jesus said, “They will see Me there.”
passages.original: τότε λέγει αὐταῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὑπάγετε ἀπαγγείλατε τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου ἵνα ἀπέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κἀκεῖ με ὄψονται

passages.text: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
passages.sermon:
Some women were going somewhere.
Some guards had watched Jesus’ tomb.
These guards went into the city.
The guards met the chief priests.
The guards told the chief priests everything that had happened.
passages.original: Πορευομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδού τινες τῆς κουστωδίας ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν ἅπαντα τὰ γενόμενα

passages.text: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
passages.sermon:
The chief priests met with the elders.
They formed a plan together.
They gave the soldiers a large amount of money.
They told the soldiers what to say.
They said, “Say this: ‘His disciples came at night.
They stole Him while we were sleeping.’”
passages.original: καὶ συναχθέντες μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων συμβούλιόν τε λαβόντες ἀργύρια ἱκανὰ ἔδωκαν τοῖς στρατιώταις λέγοντες Εἴπατε ὅτι Οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς ἐλθόντες ἔκλεψαν αὐτὸν ἡμῶν κοιμωμένων

passages.text: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
passages.sermon: The chief priests and elders spoke to the guards.\r\nThey said, "If the governor hears this report, we will persuade him."\r\nWe will keep you safe from trouble.
passages.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἀκουσθῇ τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος ἡμεῖς πείσομεν αὐτὸν καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους ποιήσομεν

passages.text: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
passages.sermon:
The guards took the money.
The chief priests and elders had given the guards a large sum of money.
The guards did exactly as they were told.
The guards spread the story that the disciples stole Jesus’ body while the guards were asleep.
Many Jews heard this story.
People have repeated this story among the Jews up to this very day.
passages.original: Οἱ δὲ λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια ἐποίησαν ὡς ἐδιδάχθησαν Καὶ διεφημίσθη ὁ λόγος οὗτος παρὰ Ἰουδαίοις μέχρι τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

passages.text: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
passages.sermon:
The eleven disciples followed Jesus.
They traveled to Galilee.
They went to the mountain.
Jesus had chosen this mountain for them.
passages.original: Οἱ δὲ ἕνδεκα μαθηταὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος οὗ ἐτάξατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς

passages.text: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.
passages.sermon: The eleven disciples saw Jesus.\r\nThey worshiped Jesus.\r\nSome disciples doubted.
passages.original: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν προσεκύνησαν οἱ δὲ ἐδίστασαν

passages.text: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus approached the eleven disciples.
Jesus spoke to them.
Jesus said, “All authority has been given to Me.
God gave Me this authority.
I have authority in heaven.
I have authority on earth.”
passages.original: Καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς λέγων Ἐδόθη μοι πᾶσα ἐξουσία ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

passages.text: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He told them to go.
He told them to make disciples of all nations.
He told them to baptize people.
They must baptize in the name of the Father.
They must baptize in the name of the Son.
They must baptize in the name of the Holy Spirit.
They must teach people to obey everything Jesus commanded them.
Jesus said He is with them always.
He will be with them to the end of the age.
passages.original: πορευθέντες οὖν μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος
